DBS Bank and Citi Partner to Enable Instant 24/7 Cross-Border USD Payments With Tokenised Deposits
summary:
Companies that transact in USD across different jurisdictions and time zones will now have the ability to execute cross-border payments without the constraint of traditional banking hours. This was made possible with the first successful USD payment between Singapore and the United States executed over a weekend. The transaction, completed by DBS and Citi’s New York office on 5 September 2026, was executed using tokenised deposits via the Swift Digital Ledger.
The transaction took minutes to complete, marking a significant improvement from the industry norm of up to two business days for cross-border payments, as companies no longer lose days to time zone and weekend gaps. For institutions operating in round-the-clock borderless industries like e-commerce and digital services, this provides greater certainty and faster access to cash for suppliers and customers. In addition, corporate treasurers can respond more effectively to changing market conditions by moving liquidity across entities and markets at a moment’s notice.
Amid market volatility and expansion into new markets, institutions are seeking smarter ways to manage liquidity and foreign exchange (FX) risk to build resilience. According to DBS’ New Realities, New Possibilities report, 50% of finance leaders are exploring blockchain-powered capabilities as part of their liquidity and FX management toolkit. In addition, the capability helps meet growing demand for cross-border transactions in Asia, with the region’s outbound cross-border payments projected to surge to USD 24 trillion by 2033, almost double that of 2025 volumes (USD 13.5 trillion).
Rachel Chew, Chief Operating Officer and Co-Head of Digital Assets, Global Transaction Services, DBS, said: “In a global digital economy that never sleeps, businesses need to move money more quickly and efficiently across borders to stay competitive. Swift Digital Ledger is bridging traditional banking infrastructures with emerging digital networks to enable deeper interoperability that benefits clients. We are pleased to be working with Citi to demonstrate how tokenised money is moving from experimentation to real-world adoption – laying the foundations for a more connected, nimble and always-on global financial system.”
Mridula Iyer, Head of Services for Asia South, Citi, said: “This milestone with DBS on Swift’s ledger reflects Citi’s commitment to building financial infrastructure for our clients and partners that is always-on, interoperable and fit for the future. Processing a live transaction over a weekend demonstrates that always-on cross-border payments are already a reality. This work is a natural extension of our strategy in the Services business to integrate our traditional cash management and securities capabilities with emerging tokenised networks and assets and deliver value to institutional clients across their local and global operating models.”
The transaction builds on DBS’ expertise in tokenised money and payments as the bank continues to expand its complete suite of digital asset solutions. In 2024, the bank launched DBS Token Services, its suite of blockchain-powered banking services that enables 24/7, programmable, secure and instantaneous value transfers. This includes DBS Treasury Tokens, the bank’s treasury and liquidity management solution powered by its permissioned blockchain. In addition, DBS is the only Asian-headquartered bank in the Swift digital ledger core design group of 12 banks shaping its architecture.

content: DBS Bank and Citi have successfully completed an instant cross-border USD payment using tokenised deposits over the Swift Digital Ledger. The transaction between Singapore and the United States was executed over a weekend, bypassing traditional banking hours. This milestone highlights the growing adoption of blockchain-powered financial infrastructure to enhance corporate liquidity and provide 24/7 payment capabilities for global businesses.

UniCredit Obtains ECB Authorization on Danish Compromise
summary:
UniCredit has been informed that the European Central Bank has granted approval for the application of the Danish Compromise methodology in the calculation of the Group's consolidated capital ratios. Starting from 3Q26 reporting, insurance holdings may be treated through risk weighting rather than being deducted from regulatory capital.
The authorization strengthens UniCredit's capital position by an estimated benefit of approximately +52bps to the CET1 ratio, based on its position as of 2Q26, delivers on the Group's commitment to obtain approval by the end of September, and further increases the disciplined capital allocation of the Group.

Adyen Powers Payments for Limitless Technology Group
summary:
Adyen, the global financial technology platform of choice for leading businesses, has announced its partnership with Limitless Technology Group, a gifting e-commerce firm headquartered in Melbourne, to streamline the firm’s payment infrastructure across its portfolio of brands and markets.
With brands like Flower Chimp, CakeRush, Bloomeroo, LVLY and Happy Bunch, Limitless Technology operates across six markets and manages its online storefronts, order fulfillment and business data through a centralized technology platform. Today, all five brands leverage Adyen’s direct local acquiring across Australia, Hong Kong, Malaysia, and Singapore, alongside cross-border transactions for the Philippines and Indonesia. 
The speed of rollout moved at the pace of the business, with Limitless Technology successfully bringing more than 10 online stores live across four markets within just one week. By consolidating four payment gateways into one, the company standardized its payments reports across markets and brands, leading to faster and simpler reconciliation on the backend. 
“Gifting is ultimately about the connection between people, and technology should make that connection easier, not more complicated,” said Niklas Frassa, CEO and Co-founder of Limitless Technology Group. “Payments are a fundamental part of that experience, and Adyen helps us ensure this happens smoothly behind the scenes, so our brands can focus on the moments they are helping customers create.”
Delivering a Simple Checkout across all Seasons
Gifting is a highly seasonal business, with occasions such as Valentine’s Day and Mother’s Day driving significant spikes in demand. During these high-transaction periods, the ability to complete a purchase without issue becomes particularly important. In fact, research from The Adyen Retail Index 2026 found that 26% of Malaysians abandon a purchase if they encounter a payment error, citing security or trust concerns.
To combat cart abandonment, Adyen equips Limitless Technology with a native checkout solution that eliminates page redirects while supporting local payment methods – thus delivering the trust, convenience, and familiarity modern shoppers expect, even during busy gifting periods.
Sharper Intelligence Informing Business Decisions
As Limitless Technology expands its portfolio and geographic footprint, its payment infrastructure needs to keep pace with different brands, markets and customer preferences. Through Adyen, the group can use data to support business intelligence, e.g. keen understanding of customers’ preferred card mix to inform card-linked offers.
“Managing payments across multiple brands and markets becomes increasingly complex as a business grows,” said Soon Yean Lee, Country Manager, Malaysia, Adyen. “Partnering with Adyen enables Limitless Technology to simplify its payment operations and gain deeper visibility into their transaction data, driving smarter, data-led decisions as the business scales.”

Application to Offer in 24 Hours With New Barclays Fast-Track Remortgage
summary:
Barclays announces new Fast-Track Remortgage service, launching 7 September 2026, designed to make remortgaging to Barclays faster and more straightforward. Customers eligible for the scheme1 can receive an offer within 24 hours and complete in as little as five days, opening up more choice for homeowners who want to explore options outside of their existing provider.
For many homeowners, renewing a mortgage is about more than simply securing a new rate. It can involve weighing up a range of important decisions while navigating what is often seen as a complex and time-consuming process. As a result, many stick with their existing lender for convenience and certainty, rather than because it offers the best option for their circumstances.
Across the market, mortgage holders who switched lenders for their most recent renewal are twice as likely to report difficulties with the process than those who stayed with their existing lender (20 per cent versus 10 per cent). Moving to a new provider has also typically been slower than staying, with just 10 per cent of recent switchers reporting that they received an offer within 24 hours, compared to 33 per cent among those who stayed.
Through Fast-Track Remortgage, homeowners no longer need to choose between convenience and exploring the wider market. Eligible customers can receive an offer within 24 hours, and for those who need to move quickly, complete in as little as five days. This enables customers to act on the best deal available, which could save them money as well as time. By prioritising key stages of the remortgage journey, Fast-Track helps reduce the time and effort involved in switching to Barclays, giving customers a viable alternative to staying with an existing lender.
An enhanced customer and broker experience
Fast-Track Remortgage gives brokers the first meaningful alternative to product transfers by helping clients secure a competitive mortgage deal without lengthy and uncertain processing times.
Half (49 per cent) of those who stayed with their last lender say that a lower interest rate from a competitor might have convinced them to switch. Through Fast-Track, eligible customers will benefit from prioritised valuations and conveyancing, which means brokers can help secure a competitive deal for their clients, without compromising on convenience.
Switch simplification
Process simplification is one of the top priorities for mortgage holders, following keeping costs down. Nearly a quarter (23 per cent) say a quicker and more straightforward application process would have made them consider switching lender. A fifth (18 per cent) also would have been motivated by less paperwork or documentation. Ease and convenience are also key drivers – three in 10 mortgage holders (31 per cent) named customer service as a reason to stay, and 29 per cent cited familiarity with their existing lender.
Jatin Patel, Head of Mortgages, Savings and Insurance at Barclays, said: “For many homeowners, renewing their mortgage deal can be stressful and time consuming. Many want to avoid remortgaging with a new lender because of the complexity and length of the process, and can find themselves restricted in choice.
“Fast-Track Remortgage has been designed to streamline switching into Barclays, removing obstacles to finding the best option for your circumstances. Eligible customers can have the certainty of an offer within 24 hours, and complete within a timeframe that works for them, without the hassle of extra admin.”
Roland McCormack, Head of Intermediaries at Barclays, said: “We know that remortgage timescales can be frustrating and unreliable, affecting client choice and leaving product transfer as the only option for certainty. Meanwhile, complexity for customers can narrow their choices before they have fully explored the market.
“We have designed Fast-Track to accelerate the process for brokers and their clients, providing a real alternative to product transfers and a more straightforward route to remortgaging with Barclays. Brokers can now focus their efforts on supporting their clients to understand their options, without time consuming processes getting in the way.”
Rachel Geddes, Strategic Lender Relationship Director, Mortgage Advice Bureau, said: "We're incredibly proud of the work we've done to support Barclays in bringing the Fast-Track Remortgage to market.
“Where clients have previously faced waits of several months in some cases to become remortgage ready, this new proposition means that can now happen in as little as 24 hours. That's a genuine step change for both clients and brokers. We're excited about the benefit this will bring, and proud to have played our part in delivering it."
With Fast-Track Remortgage, eligible customers could receive an offer within 24 hours and complete a remortgage in as little as five days. Eligible homeowners can apply by booking an appointment with a mortgage broker or one of our mortgage advisors.

Sol og Strand Selects Shift4 to Upgrade Payments and Elevate the Guest Experience Across Its Danish Holiday-Home Network
summary:
Shift4, a global leader in integrated payments and commerce technology, has been selected by Sol og Strand, one of Denmark’s largest holiday-home rental agencies, to provide payment processing across its portfolio of more than 7,000 privately owned properties.
Founded in 1979, Sol og Strand offers holiday homes and apartments throughout Denmark, including Bornholm, Skagen, Blokhus, Blåvand and Fanø. Its properties range from smaller coastal cottages to large family properties and holiday homes with pools.
Under the partnership, Shift4 becomes Sol og Strand’s payment processing partner for online bookings, handling transactions and settlement through its payments infrastructure. By introducing T+1 settlement, Shift4 gives Sol og Strand access to funds the next business day, helping it to manage cash flow more effectively.
The arrangement is built around the specific demands of the holiday-home rental sector, including seasonal booking patterns, refunds, chargebacks, and additional payments that can arise after a guest has checked out.
This post-stay payment capability is a key part of the agreement. Where an additional amount is due under the terms of the booking – for cleaning, utilities or property damage, for example – Shift4 enables it to be charged to the card used to make the original reservation, subject to the relevant authorisation and card scheme requirements.
By moving routine payment tasks into the background, the partnership is designed to let Sol og Strand's teams focus on what guests actually come for: the holiday experience, from arrival to check-out and beyond.
Previously, these charges had to be collected through a separate invoice. The new process will reduce administration for Sol og Strand’s teams, allow balances to be collected more quickly, and give guests a simpler way to pay – so the payment side of a stay stays out of the way of the experience itself.
Jens Frandsen, Chief Financial Officer at Sol og Strand, commented: “Holiday-home rentals come with some very specific payment challenges. Booking volumes change substantially throughout the year, and there are times when an additional charge needs to be settled after a guest has returned home. We chose Shift4 because the team understood how our business works and was willing to build around what we actually need.
“Faster settlement and a simpler way to handle post-stay charges will make a real positive difference to our teams and guests. As we continue to grow, we need payment infrastructure that can grow with us, and that’s what Shift4 will provide.”
Spokesperson Ruben Nielson, Director Business Development – Nordics, at Shift4, added: “Payments should never be the thing guests remember about their stay – the holiday experience should. Travel payments are rarely as straightforward as taking the initial booking. Holiday-rental businesses must manage deposits, refunds, seasonal demand, and charges that may only become clear after a stay has ended.
“Our work with Sol og Strand is about solving those problems so the experience stays front and centre for guests. T+1 settlement will give the business faster access to its funds, while the post-stay payment capability replaces a slow, manual invoicing process. It’s a good example of how payment infrastructure can be adapted to the commercial needs of a particular sector, and we’re pleased to be working with Sol og Strand to deliver it.”
Sol og Strand joins Shift4’s growing portfolio of Nordic and European merchant partners. The partnership builds on Shift4’s work in the travel sector, combining global payments infrastructure with local expertise and commercial flexibility to support the practical requirements of travel and holiday-rental businesses – and to help ensure the guest experience is never interrupted by friction at the payment stage.

content: Sol og Strand has partnered with Shift4 to upgrade payment processing across its holiday-home network in Denmark. The agreement introduces T+1 settlement and specialized post-stay payment capabilities for handling utilities, cleaning, and damage charges. This integration aims to streamline seasonal booking operations, improve cash flow, and reduce administrative tasks for the rental agency while enhancing the overall guest experience.

SIX Launches Affordable European Market Data Alternative
summary:
SIX has launched a new data marketplace today that will make data more accessible and affordable through an API-based solution for both institutional and retail traders. The service, SIX Market Signal, publishes real-time and historical data. For institutions, it enables access to market data across a wider variety of users while for the retail clients, it provides first-of-its-kind direct access to real-time exchange data. 
The key offering of SIX Market Signal is 1BBO, a European market data stream that will provide real-time coverage of cash equity securities. It will display best bid and ask prices and utilize data from the orderbooks of SIX Swiss Exchange and BME Exchange in Switzerland and Spain and will also include the 16 European markets covered by Aquis Exchange. Only direct data feeds, used by market makers and execution desks, will have faster access to prices. 1BBO will be complimented by historical and intraday data products, with more datasets expected to be added to the SIX Market Signal marketplace over time.  
SIX Market Signal allows firms to expand access to market data beyond the execution desk to other functions such as wealth management, benchmarking, and compliance. It serves as an alternative for businesses that can benefit from real-time price streaming.  
For retail traders, SIX Market Signal provides access to high‑quality exchange data that balances cost and speed for everyday investor use cases. Through 1BBO, SIX aims to level the playing field for retail investors. 
Users of the new service will also be fully licensed to use the data to train trading models and AI agents, with the data provided through APIs. This enables retail investors, fintechs, banks, brokers, and other market participants to incorporate SIX Market Signal into a variety of use cases without onerous conditions or restrictions. 
SIX Market Signal leverages viaNexus technology to enable real-time data distribution, entitlement management, cloud API delivery, and integration into AI and quantitative workflows. 
SIX Market Signal is available for institutional investors now. Swiss retail investors will be able to subscribe the service immediately, with further rollouts planned for retail participants in the EU and the UK. 
Santiago Ximenez, Head Data & Connectivity, Exchanges, SIX, commented: “With Market Signal, SIX is removing the barriers when accessing high‑quality exchange data across European capital markets. By leveraging our European footprint, we enable a broader set of market participants to gain timely, reliable price insights that support informed decisions.”

The service aims to lower barriers to high-quality exchange data, with immediate availability for institutions and Swiss retail users, followed by upcoming EU and UK rollouts.

Deloitte Ireland Partners With AccountsIQ to Automate Financial Reporting for Mid-Market Businesses
summary:
AccountsIQ, the leading cloud accounting platform for mid-market businesses has announced its strategic partnership with Deloitte Ireland Corporate Finance to better support mid-market companies through periods of growth and transformation. Deloitte Ireland Corporate Finance works with around 200 mid-market companies annually, many of which are preparing for growth, investment, restructuring or sale.
 
Deloitte Ireland Corporate Finance identified a growing gap in the market for scaling businesses with revenues between £30 million and £100 million. While entry-level finance systems often lacked the sophistication required to support increasing operational and reporting complexity, larger enterprise platforms could be costly, resource-intensive, and overly complex to implement. As a result, Deloitte Ireland Corporate Finance recognised AccountsIQ as a strong fit for its mid-sized clients seeking a more scalable and insight-driven finance platform, particularly with many outgrowing Sage 50 or spreadsheet-based operations. 
 
AccountsIQ’s cloud accounting software streamlines businesses' workflows, delivering next-level insights and empowering better business decisions and faster results. The platform provides multi-entity finance management and a clear dashboard to help firms modernise finance operations with AI automation.
 
Ian Whitefoot, Partner at Deloitte Ireland Corporate Finance, said, “In recent years, we’ve seen a significant increase in the attractiveness of Irish SME assets and companies to PE investors in Ireland, the UK and the US. 
 
“When institutional investors enter the market to buy businesses, there is an expectation for a step up in financial reporting. Many need to know how financial information is maintained and how it is reported against the value case for an acquisition. Spreadsheets cannot be relied upon when reaching this stage.
 
“Considering this, we are pleased to introduce our portfolio companies to an award-winning finance platform designed for the next stage of growth. Businesses acquired by Private Equity firms often carry accounting inaccuracies, something that can now be solved by the AccountsIQ platform, which offers implementation costs suited to Private Equity houses' post-investment budgets.”
Darren Cran, CEO of AccountsIQ, added, “Deloitte works with some of the world’s leading business teams and, with this partnership, we can help ambitious mid-market companies build finance functions fit for growth
“Unlike many competing platforms, our platform is designed with mid-market businesses in mind. In the age of AI and automation, AccountsIQ's current features and product roadmap will support Deloitte Ireland's future strategy.”

SumUp Becomes Manchester United’s Official Sleeve Partner
summary:
Manchester United and SumUp today announced a multi-year partnership that will see the leading global fintech company become the club’s Official Shirt Sleeve Partner. 
The new agreement, which begins with Manchester United’s return to the UEFA Champions League on Thursday, will see the SumUp logo feature on the shirt sleeve of the men’s, women’s and academy teams across all competitions. SumUp will also feature prominently on matchdays at Old Trafford and the Progress with Unity Stadium. 
Through the partnership, fans will have more opportunities to connect with the club through exclusive giveaways, competitions and experiences. Together, Manchester United and SumUp will also launch a co-branded payment card which will offer fans special offers and rewards when used with official club outlets, as well as businesses across the UK. 
Marc Armstrong, Chief Business Officer at Manchester United, said: 
“SumUp is a rapidly growing global business and we are delighted to welcome them to Manchester United as our Official Sleeve Partner. The new agreement supports our commercial growth strategy and reflects the continued appeal of Manchester United as a platform for ambitious brands looking to connect with audiences around the world. 
“We look forward to working closely with SumUp to bring them closer to our global fanbase, helping them tell their story on a worldwide stage and supporting the next chapter of their impressive growth journey.” 
Luke Griffiths, Chief Commercial Officer and UK CEO, SumUp, said: 
“Manchester United is one of the most iconic and followed clubs in the world, with a fanbase that continues to grow across generations and borders. That extraordinary reach and passion make this partnership a natural fit for SumUp. 
“Football is about the moments people share: watching the match with friends, travelling to see the team, wearing the shirt with pride and celebrating together, wherever you are. From fans using SumUp Personal Account to manage and spend their money simply, to the businesses that help make matchdays special, SumUp is part of the everyday moments that bring people together. 
“Through this partnership, we want to connect with Manchester United fans in those moments, introducing more people to SumUp and creating experiences that make being a supporter even more rewarding. We look forward to bringing the energy, ambition and spirit of Manchester United to life for fans everywhere.” 
SumUp empowers businesses of all sizes with simple, smart tools to help them run and grow. For consumers, the SumUp Personal Account provides an easier, more intelligent way to manage and spend their money.
